projectGuide.name: AskYRA Tech
projectGuide.overview: AskYRA Tech is a cybersecurity training and services website with a React frontend and an Express/MongoDB API. The backend is authoritative for course prices and payment amounts.

technology.frontend: React 19, React Router 7, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS 4, Lucide React, Oxlint
technology.backend: Node.js ES modules, Express 4, Mongoose 8, MongoDB, Zod, bcryptjs, JWT, Nodemailer, Helmet, CORS, express-rate-limit

security.item: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt on the server. Send passwords over HTTPS; do not send client-generated hashes.
New passwords require 12+ characters, upper/lowercase letters, a number and a symbol.
Email OTP has six digits, expires in 10 minutes and allows up to five attempts.
Authentication routes allow 10 requests per 15 minutes per client IP; general API traffic allows 120 requests per minute.
Session is a signed 12-hour JWT in an HTTP-only cookie.
API request bodies are limited to 32 KB. Helmet, CORS allowlisting and rate limits are enabled.
Admin registration is disabled; admin is bootstrapped from environment configuration.
Payment callbacks are verified server-side. Bank transfers require administrator verification.

deployment.backend: Deploy backend/ as the Vercel project root and configure required backend environment variables.
deployment.frontend: Deploy frontend/ as the frontend project root. Set VITE_API_URL if the API is not at the configured default.
deployment.cors: Set CLIENT_ORIGIN to the exact frontend domain(s); use comma-separated origins for multiple trusted domains.
deployment.payments: Use HTTPS callback URLs. Live payment mode is blocked by current code pending production review.

limitations.item: Course catalog and prices are static backend data and have no admin editing endpoint.
No card processor is configured; do not collect card data.
Backend npm test currently reports zero tests.
